tasks.short: Relay messages to sites and other agencies.

steps.what: Hear the messages for groups requiring notification.
Tell enforcement agencies and other individuals.
Note the relay the dispatcher already gave.

tasks.design: The dispatcher relays information to the emergency site and tells other agencies by voice. A note records the relay they already gave. No notice is sent to a site that the dispatcher did not speak to.
tasks.previous_blocker: The relay was a radio call, and the same facts were written afterwards.
tasks.enabler_now: The console can hold a short note after the voice relay. It cannot make the relay.
tasks.still_hard: People at the site need to hear a person, and the set of agencies changes with the situation.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher decides who is told and speaks the message. A note is not a notification.
tasks.altitude: The relay stays on the radio. The note afterwards is only a little shorter, and the dispatcher still checks it.

reach.task: Hear a relay from the desk
reach.learn: Take the information from the dispatcher's voice

evidence.claim: A short note can record a relay the dispatcher has already spoken.

assumptions: The workflow starts when there is something to pass on and ends when the note is written. The voice relay is not replaced by a message.
The note fields are who was told and a short subject. The dispatcher writes them after speaking. There is no automatic notification and no audio record.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree.
Upkeep is small: the note uses agency names the service already keeps.
unknowns: Which agencies must be told by voice rather than by a later note.
Whether the console already marks a radio transmission.
research_questions: Which notifications must stay on the radio?
Does the console already mark that a transmission was made?

already_counted.description: Relaying information to the site stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: No new agency list; the note uses names already kept

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conservative case keeps the voice relay in full. The low end moves only the later note, and only when that note is still a second writing. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Record details of calls, dispatches, and messages.

steps.what: Keep the timestamp of calls the console already stores.
Record details of calls the dispatcher heard.
Add the dispatches the dispatcher already made.
Review messages included in the record.
File the record the dispatcher accepted.

tasks.design: The console already stores the call timestamp, and that time is not treated as saved work. The dispatcher records the details, adds the dispatches they already made, and reviews any messages in the record. {OPS_SYSTEM} files the accepted record. It does not write the narrative.
tasks.previous_blocker: Details were written on a card and typed again after the call.
tasks.enabler_now: The console can keep one record of what the dispatcher typed, instead of a second typing.
tasks.still_hard: The words of the call are still the dispatcher's, and a message can contain something that should not be copied in full.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher writes the details. The file stores them. It does not describe the call.
tasks.altitude: Typing the details stays. The second copy of an accepted record is shorter. The timestamp the console already keeps is not a saving.

reach.learn: Read a record only after the dispatcher has accepted it

evidence.claim: A call record can be filed from details the dispatcher typed and then accepted.
Audio of the call is not stored by this step. The record is what the dispatcher typed.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the call has a timestamp and ends when the accepted record is filed. Priority and dispatch stay in the tasks where the dispatcher decides them.

The fields are call id, the dispatcher's text, the units they already dispatched, and their acceptance. The dispatcher produces the text. The timestamp is an existing system field and is not a saving. No audio is stored.
The prior treats the task as automate. The steps disagree in part: the timestamp is existing system work. The narrative stays the dispatcher's typing.
Upkeep is keeping the record fields the service is allowed to store.
unknowns: Whether a second typing still happens after the console record.
How long call records are kept under national rules.
research_questions: Is the narrative still typed twice, once on paper and once on the console?
How long must the call record be kept?

already_counted.description: Reviewing the typed record stays partly in that step

incremental.description: Keep the record fields the service is allowed to store

approvals.approved_version: call record the dispatcher accepted after typing the details

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the console is already the only place details are typed, the file step shrinks and the low end is mostly the typing, which stays. The timestamp the console already stores is excluded either way. 22 percent is work the system already does and is not saved human labour. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Monitor radio frequencies for developing situations.

steps.what: Monitor radio frequencies during the shift.
Note a developing situation heard on the radio.
Mark public works or civil defense traffic in the log.

tasks.design: The dispatcher monitors the radio, including public works, school security, and civil defense, and decides what is a developing situation. A log line is marked by the dispatcher. Nothing listens in their place.
tasks.previous_blocker: Monitoring the radio is listening, which a stored feed summary would not do reliably for this desk.
tasks.enabler_now: The console can hold a line the dispatcher marks after they have heard something.
tasks.still_hard: Several frequencies run at once, and what matters depends on the rest of the shift.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher hears the radio and decides what is developing. A log does not listen.
tasks.altitude: Monitoring stays the whole of the listening. Marking a line afterwards is only a little shorter.

reach.learn: Treat a situation as noted only after the dispatcher has marked it

evidence.claim: A radio log line can be stored after the dispatcher has decided that something is developing.

assumptions: The workflow starts when the shift's radios are on and ends when a marked line is stored. Dispatching a unit stays in its own task.
The line fields are frequency and a short note the dispatcher wrote. No recording of the radio is made.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree on the monitoring.
Upkeep is keeping the list of frequencies the desk still monitors.
unknowns: Which frequencies this desk must monitor besides the main channel.
Whether any radio is already recorded. This design does not add a recording.
research_questions: Which extra frequencies does the desk monitor?
Is any radio already recorded, and who agreed to that?

already_counted.description: Monitoring the radio stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: Keep the list of frequencies the desk monitors

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The conservative case keeps the listening in full. The low end moves only the marked line, which is a small share. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Read maps on screen and provide directions.

steps.what: Read small-scale maps on the computer screen.
Interpret the map and determine locations.
Check the information against what the caller said.
Provide directions from the location just determined.

tasks.design: The dispatcher reads the map on the screen, determines the location, checks it with the caller, and provides directions by voice. The screen does not choose the location or speak the directions.
tasks.previous_blocker: The map was already on a screen. Reading it and giving directions were the work.
tasks.enabler_now: A clearer map still needs the dispatcher to interpret it for this call.
tasks.still_hard: Small-scale maps hide a building entrance, and a caller's landmark may not be on the map.
tasks.human_edge: The dispatcher determines the location and provides the directions.
tasks.altitude: Reading the map is slightly easier to open. Interpreting it and providing directions stay with the dispatcher.

reach.task: Follow a direction to a location
reach.learn: Use the direction the dispatcher gave, not a pin alone

evidence.claim: A map on the existing screen can be opened to a place name. The reading and the direction stay with the dispatcher.

assumptions: The workflow starts when a place must be found and ends when the directions have been spoken. No route is sent to a unit automatically.
No new location is stored by a model. The dispatcher determines it. If the map has no match, the dispatcher says so and keeps questioning.
The prior treats the task as human. The steps agree.
Upkeep is keeping the map layers the service already pays for. No new layer is added here.
unknowns: Whether the map already shows the service boundary.
How often a caller's landmark is missing from the map.
research_questions: Does the current map show the service boundary?
What does the dispatcher do when the landmark is not on the map?

already_counted.description: Interpreting the map stays in full inside that step

incremental.description: No new map layer is added

time_saved_range_pct.basis: If the map is no easier to open than today, the low end falls to the interpretation and the directions, which stay in full. Provisional, not a measured result.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Relaying to a site, monitoring the radio, and giving directions stay on the dispatcher's voice and ears. The call record is filed from what they typed. The console's existing timestamp is not treated as time saved.
reach: A supervisor reads a call record only after the dispatcher has accepted it
skills_to_grow: Typing the call details without a transcript
Relaying by voice before any note
Providing directions from a map they have interpreted
role.ambitious_version: The record matches what the dispatcher heard and typed, and every direction was one they gave.
